evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced.
